title: 激光焊接与切割工艺
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/193_激光焊接与切割工艺.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/193_激光焊接与切割工艺/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块焊缝发黑的钢板和一块切不透的钢板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a steel plate with a blackened weld and another plate with an incomplete cut, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十一课：激光焊接与切割工艺。

shots.scene: 阿杰切不透，伸手要把功率调到最大
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a half cut steel plate and reaches to turn a power setting to maximum on a blank screen, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：切不透？功率开到最大！

shots.scene: 小研拦住，指着切割嘴和气压表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the cutting nozzle and a gas pressure gauge, a magnifier icon.
shots.narration: 小研：先查嘴、红光和气压。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds an open manual and a checklist with three cause icons.
shots.narration: 老李：参数照说明书，要改找负责人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strong neat flat weld bead with three checkmark icons for strength, appearance and no distortion. No text.
shots.narration: 焊缝目标：牢固、美观、不变形。

shots.scene: 焊台、焊接服、眼镜、面罩、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal welding table, a flame resistant welding jacket, laser safety glasses, a face shield and gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 备好焊台、焊接服、防护镜和手套。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three blocks for preparation steps, welding modes and practical tips. No text.
shots.narration: 本课先讲准备，再讲模式和技巧。

shots.scene: 按推荐设保护气，看实际气压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shielding gas cylinder of nitrogen or argon icon, a status screen showing actual gas pressure while gas flows. No text.
shots.narration: 按推荐选氮气或氩气，通气看气压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dirty and a cracked protective lens with a falling power arrow, a clean lens checked. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片脏了坏了，功率下降焊不好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the nozzle scale tube aligned with the focus reference mark. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接嘴刻度，对准焦距参考值。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thicker plates and wider gaps paired with thicker filler wire, a very thin plate welded without wire. No text.
shots.narration: 缝宽板厚丝要粗，很薄可不填丝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stainless steel plate matched with a stainless wire spool, an aluminium wire with a steel plate crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊丝材质要和工件一样。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关机状态下把焊丝卡进焊接嘴槽
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers seating the filler wire into the groove of a welding nozzle on a powered off handheld welder.
shots.narration: 焊丝要卡在焊接嘴的槽里。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand wiping the joint of two steel plates with an alcohol wipe before welding, no welder running.
shots.narration: 焊前清掉油污灰尘。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet joint with a clock, then a dry joint ready, an alcohol bottle kept away from the welding area. No text.
shots.narration: 擦完等它干透，酒精移开再焊。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three mode icons, a single dot, a continuous line and a chain of overlapping scales. No text.
shots.narration: 高级模式里有三种焊接模式。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single short laser pulse forming one weld spot fixing two thin parts. No text.
shots.narration: 点焊出一次光，常用来打定位点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small precise spot with low heat, a strength gauge only half full. No text.
shots.narration: 精度高变形小，但不够牢。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a continuous weld line sealing a joint, a load and a sealing icon. No text.
shots.narration: 连续焊光不停，要承重密封就用它。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin plate with a burn through hole and warping from continuous heat. No text.
shots.narration: 牢固密封，但薄板易烧穿、变形。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a weld run from start to end in one pass, the wire staying on the seam, the torch not dragged back. No text.
shots.narration: 位置确认后，一口气焊到底。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tack points at both ends of a joint and extra tacks along the middle of a long part. No text.
shots.narration: 先打定位点，长件中间多加几个。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an angle joint pulled inward after cooling, a pre set opening angle compensating it. No text.
shots.narration: 连续焊会把角拉小，可预留角度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feed switch turned off for tacking, then turned back on for the continuous weld. No text.
shots.narration: 关送丝打点，切回连续焊再打开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: overlapping round weld pools forming a fish scale pattern, between a spot and a continuous weld. No text.
shots.narration: 脉冲焊点状熔池叠成鱼鳞纹。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reflective plate welded with pulses, the back side clean and flat, a sealing gauge slightly lower. No text.
shots.narration: 变形小，背面无痕，密封稍差。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power slider, higher giving deeper penetration and lower giving less blackening. No text.
shots.narration: 要更牢加功率，要少发黑减功率。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three more sliders for beam width, frequency and wire feed speed. No text.
shots.narration: 宽度、频率、送丝速度也能调。

shots.scene: 以说明书为准，负责人改
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a manual icon and a responsible person icon approving a change, a student pushing every slider to maximum crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 数值以说明书为准，大改找负责人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: parts raised on supports so the seam is off the table, a part welded onto the table crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接区架空，免得焊在台面上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the nozzle at forty five degrees to the seam, the wire tip touching the work and the red dot on the joint. No text.
shots.narration: 嘴与焊缝成45度，红光落焊位。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the torch lifted straight away at the end of the weld, a stuck wire icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊完马上抬起，防止粘丝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stuck wire, wire feed switched off, one short pulse while lifting, yanking and wiggling crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 粘住别硬拽，关送丝出一次光抬起。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welder switched off, the wire guide and welding nozzle removed and a cleaning nozzle fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 焊缝发黑：先关机，换清洗嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cleaning mode selected, the head held parallel to the seam and moved along it, laser glasses on the operator icon. No text.
shots.narration: 选清洗，平行焊缝移动清理。

shots.scene: 不求高强度可减板厚设置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bright clean weld with no black edge, a thickness setting lowered slightly for a cosmetic weld. No text.
shots.narration: 不求高强度，板厚可设小些少发黑。

shots.scene: 不出光多半联锁没闭合
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch not firing, an open interlock icon and a laser enable switch in the off position. No text.
shots.narration: 不出光，多半联锁没闭合或没使能。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed loop from the work clamp through the work to the nozzle, an open loop blocking the laser. No text.
shots.narration: 工件夹没夹好，回路断开不出光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an interlock shield protecting a person, a bypass wire on the interlock crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 这是保护人的机制，不得短接。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welder switched off, the wire removed, the welding nozzle pulled out and a cutting nozzle fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 手持切割：先关机，拆丝换切割嘴。

shots.scene: 【实拍】切割嘴刻度对准参考值
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands sliding the scale tube of a cutting nozzle to a reference mark on a powered off handheld welder.
shots.narration: 切割嘴刻度对准参考值。

shots.scene: 流量计换成减压阀压力表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flow meter on the cylinder replaced with a pressure regulator with gauges, compressed air, nitrogen or argon icons. No text.
shots.narration: 流量计换成减压阀，气压按说明书调。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crisp round red dot checked, a broken blurred dot leading to a burnt nozzle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 红光不清晰先校准，否则烧喷嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate with the cutting line over an open gap between supports, an alcohol wipe cleaning the surface. No text.
shots.narration: 切割区悬空，表面擦净油污。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a marked guide line for a curve and a straight edge clamped along a straight cut, a numerical control machine icon for precision parts. No text.
shots.narration: 曲线画引导线，直线压靠板防切偏。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a flame resistant jacket, gloves and laser safety glasses rated for the welder wavelength stands at a screened cutting bay.
shots.narration: 出光前穿好焊接服，戴齐防护。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cutting nozzle touching the plate at forty five degrees and pulled back slowly, a fast pull leaving an uncut line. No text.
shots.narration: 嘴贴工件成45度，慢慢往后拉。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spark spray direction cleared of people and combustible items, a fire extinguisher nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 火花方向不能有人和杂物。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the laser enable switched off right after the cut, a hot plate and nozzle with heat waves and a gloved hand. No text.
shots.narration: 切完马上关出光，烫件别空手碰。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three cause icons, preparation, technique and parameters, around a half cut plate. No text.
shots.narration: 切不透：准备、操作、参数三类原因。

shots.scene: 参数核对，负责人调，报修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: material and thickness checked first, a responsible person icon adjusting power, then a report folder sent for repair. No text.
shots.narration: 先核材料厚度，再由负责人调或报修。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small steel spice rack hanging on a wall by its holes. No text.
shots.narration: 实用作品：靠孔挂墙的调料架。

shots.scene: 材料厚度决定气嘴气压参数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a material and thickness icon pointing to gas, nozzle, pressure and parameter icons. No text.
shots.narration: 先定材料厚度，它决定气嘴和参数。

shots.scene: 空压机接冷干机接焊机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an air compressor feeding a refrigerated dryer feeding the welder, inlet and outlet arrows marked by icons. No text.
shots.narration: 空压机接冷干机，冷干机接焊机。

shots.scene: 先开冷干机再开空压机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dryer switched on first, then the compressor, a clock waiting for pressure to build. No text.
shots.narration: 先开冷干机，再开空压机等产气。

shots.scene: 焊接头装上滑架，换省气嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding head aligned on carriage pins, a gas saving cutting nozzle screwed on, heat resistant gloves on hands. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接头装上滑架，换省气嘴拧紧。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands peeling protective film from a thin steel sheet and sliding both ends into the clamp slots of a powered off cutting frame.
shots.narration: 撕掉保护膜，两端插进夹具对齐。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: slats placed teeth up, a linkage bar lowered and the clamp knobs tightened on both sides. No text.
shots.narration: 放下联动杆，拧紧两侧旋钮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the frame connected to a laptop and switched on, the welder screen showing a safety notice being read before confirming. No text.
shots.narration: 两台开机，读完安全须知再确认。

shots.scene: 摄像头定位，导入图纸选参数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a camera view of the sheet, a part drawing imported, then mode, material, nozzle and gas selected to match what is fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 导入零件图，模式材料嘴气都选对。

shots.scene: 引入线把缺陷留在外面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short lead in line starting outside a part contour, the pierce mark left on the scrap side. No text.
shots.narration: 厚板加引入线，起切缺陷留在外面。

shots.scene: 外轮廓外引入，孔内引入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solid outer contour with an outside lead in and a hole with a shorter inside lead in placed in the scrap. No text.
shots.narration: 实心轮廓加外引入，孔加内引入。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lead in length linked to plate thickness with a manual icon. No text.
shots.narration: 引入线长度按软件推荐和说明书。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capacitive height sensor calibrated on a solid area, then a frame trace around the design with a margin from the sheet edge. No text.
shots.narration: 实心处校准传感器，走边框留边距。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gantry pushed forward and a cutting head knob turned to the value shown by the prompt, dross and incomplete cut icons if wrong. No text.
shots.narration: 按提示调好切割头旋钮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid closed, fume extraction running and the start button pressed, an operator watching through the window. No text.
shots.narration: 关好盖、开排烟，按开始键切割。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heat resistant gloves tapping parts free with a small hammer, the clamps loosened and the tray pulled out. No text.
shots.narration: 戴耐热手套，敲下零件，取出底板。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cutting nozzle removed and the welding nozzle refitted, its scale matched to the reference. No text.
shots.narration: 拆切割嘴装回焊接嘴，刻度对准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】泄压归零后拔旧气管插氮气管
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a pressure gauge at zero, then fingers pressing a push fit collar to pull out the old hose and insert a nitrogen hose, gas valves closed.
shots.narration: 换气先泄压归零，再拔管插管。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with one gauge for cylinder pressure and one for outlet, the knob adjusted while gas flows. No text.
shots.narration: 一表看瓶内一表看输出，按说明书调。

shots.scene: 选焊接参数，启用送丝出光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welding mode, material, thickness and wire diameter selected, the wire tip aligned to the red dot. No text.
shots.narration: 选好参数，丝尖对准红光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rack parts held in a fixture, both ends tacked first, then a forty five degree weld pulled steadily along the seam. No text.
shots.narration: 先点两端，45度顺着推力焊到底。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lightly loaded joint welded only at a few corners, the finished spice rack. No text.
shots.narration: 受力小的地方，焊几个角就行。

shots.scene: 比幅面还长的板分段切
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long thin stainless sheet longer than the machine bed, cut in two sections. No text.
shots.narration: 比幅面长的板，切一段挪一段。

shots.scene: 【实拍】板材从侧槽穿入，两端等距
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a long thin sheet slid through the side slot of a powered off cutting frame, a tape measure checking equal overhang at both ends.
shots.narration: 从侧槽穿入，两端到机架距离相等。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: both clamp knobs tightened, a cutting nozzle fitted and the compressed air supply connected. No text.
shots.narration: 拧紧夹具，装切割嘴接好气源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed letter O cut out with its inner piece falling away. No text.
shots.narration: 封闭字母直接切，内芯会掉下来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrow bridge rectangle added across the O, subtracted to keep the centre, then holes and frame merged with letters on top. No text.
shots.narration: 加一条连接筋，再把图形合成一体。

shots.scene: 旋转90度，分割线放空白处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long design rotated ninety degrees with the split line placed in a blank gap between letters. No text.
shots.narration: 旋转图案，分割线尽量放空白处。

shots.scene: 矩形相减分左右，删多余线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a copy of the design split by rectangles into left and right halves in two colours, extra lines trimmed away. No text.
shots.narration: 矩形相减分两半，删掉多余线。

shots.scene: 第二段先关输出，留边距
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the second half output turned off, the first half kept a margin from the sheet edge, gas and nozzle matching the fitted ones. No text.
shots.narration: 第二段先关输出，离板边留距离。

shots.scene: 校准走边框，关盖切第一段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the height sensor calibrated, a frame trace checked, a checklist confirmed and the lid closed for the first section. No text.
shots.narration: 校准、走边框、逐项核对，切第一段。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heat resistant gloves sliding the sheet parallel to the right, both overhangs measured equal again before tightening. No text.
shots.narration: 板很烫，戴手套平移，两端等距。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the red dot lowered to shrink onto the end of the first cut line, an arrow tip on the crosshair and its coordinates noted. No text.
shots.narration: 红光对准接缝点，记下坐标。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two marked points joined by a line, its angle compared with ninety degrees and the design rotated back by the difference. No text.
shots.narration: 对不上就用两点坐标算偏转角。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the arrow deleted, the second section output turned on, a frame trace checked and the second section cut. No text.
shots.narration: 打开第二段，必须先走边框再切。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the finished long sheet pushed out of the side slot with an almost invisible joint. No text.
shots.narration: 推出板材，接缝几乎看不出来。

shots.scene: 关光关气关机，清理记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: laser off, gas off, power off, debris cleared and a use log filled in. No text.
shots.narration: 用完关光关气关机，清理并记录。

shots.scene: 准备：气、镜片、焦距、焊丝、清洁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five preparation icons in a row, gas, lens, focus scale, wire and a cleaning wipe. No text.
shots.narration: 焊前备好气、镜片、焦距和焊丝。

shots.scene: 点焊连续焊脉冲焊，参数照说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: spot, continuous and pulse weld icons with a manual icon. No text.
shots.narration: 三种模式各有用处，参数照说明书。

shots.scene: 切不透查准备、操作、参数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three cause icons with checkmarks and laser safety glasses beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 切不透查三因，戴好防护再出光。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一卷焊丝和几个喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a spool of filler wire and several nozzles beside a wire feeder, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：送丝机、焊丝与喷嘴。
